obligations.quote: The request for proposals shall also specify the criteria to be used to evaluate the responses and the relative weight of each of such criteria.
obligations.law_title: Enacts the Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act

obligations.action_summary: Award the design-build contract to the responsive and responsible proposer offering the best value.
obligations.quote: Any contract awarded pursuant to this act shall be awarded to a responsive and responsible proposer, which, in consideration of these and other specified criteria deemed pertinent, offers the best value, as determined by the authorized entity.
obligations.law_title: Enacts the Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act

obligations.action_summary: Score all proposals by the published criteria and publish the final scores on the authority's website.
obligations.quote: All proposals submitted shall be scored according to the criteria listed in the request for proposals and such final scores shall be published on the authorized entity's website.
obligations.law_title: Enacts the Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act

obligations.action_summary: Specify that businesses certified as minority- or women-owned under state or local law qualify for any quantitative bid factor it adopts.
obligations.quote: Where the authorized entity identifies a quantitative factor pursuant to this paragraph, the authorized entity must specify that businesses certified as minority- or women-owned business enterprises pursuant to article 15-A of the executive law as well as those certified as minority- or women-owned business enterprises pursuant to local law are eligible to qualify for such factor.
obligations.law_title: Enacts the Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act

obligations.action_summary: Subject each authorized project to environmental quality review under article 8 of the environmental conservation law and the national environmental policy act where applicable.
obligations.quote: Any authorized project undertaken by an authorized entity pursuant to this act shall be subject to the requirements of article 8 of the environmental conservation law, and, where applicable, the requirements of the national environmental policy act.
obligations.law_title: Enacts the Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act

obligations.action_summary: Preserve and protect the employment rights, civil service and collective bargaining status of its employees connected with the authorized projects.
obligations.quote: all rights or benefits, including terms and conditions of employment, and protection of civil service and collective bargaining status of all employees of authorized entities solely in connection with the public works identified in subdivision six of section two of this act, shall be preserved and protected.
obligations.law_title: Enacts the Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act

obligations.action_summary: Assign employees in newly created titles to the appropriate bargaining unit.
obligations.quote: Employees of authorized entities using design-build contracts serving in positions in newly created titles shall be assigned to the appropriate bargaining unit.
obligations.law_title: Enacts the Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act

obligations.action_summary: Determine up to five hundred positions that disabled veterans can perform and fill them in the noncompetitive class, now without a wartime service requirement.
obligations.quote: Upon such determination, the said positions shall be classified in the noncompetitive class, and may be filled only by veterans of the armed forces of the United States
